product: Usable at 8: short words or icons, no reading-heavy menus, big touch targets, nothing that needs typing to make progress (voice or picking works).
AI filter on every prompt and every result, tuned for children, on both cloud and local AI.
In-app report and block for anything the AI or another player made, without leaving the game; Google Play and Apple require it, Steam asks how guardrails work.
No personal data to an AI provider without a parent's consent; say which provider gets what (Apple 5.1.2(i)). Cloud AI on a child account means the parent's AI account and consent.
Local AI as the child-safe default where possible: nothing leaves the device.
Purchases only through the store's own payment and its parent approval (Ask to Buy, Family Link, Steam Families, Cabined Accounts); no links to outside payment.
No chat with strangers, ads or tracking in the child experience; sharing creations later needs moderation.
The store's age rating questionnaire answered honestly for AI-generated content.
